-- anything depending on the badge tables (views, functions, FKs from other tables, triggers)
select 'fk' kind, conrelid::regclass::text obj, conname name from pg_constraint where contype='f' and confrelid in ('public.badges'::regclass,'public.member_badges'::regclass)
union all
select 'view', dv.oid::regclass::text, '' from pg_depend d join pg_rewrite r on r.oid=d.objid join pg_class dv on dv.oid=r.ev_class where d.refobjid in ('public.badges'::regclass,'public.member_badges'::regclass) and dv.oid not in ('public.badges'::regclass,'public.member_badges'::regclass)
union all
select 'func', p.oid::regprocedure::text, '' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.prosrc ilike '%badge%'
union all
select 'trigger', tgrelid::regclass::text, tgname from pg_trigger where not tgisinternal and tgrelid in ('public.badges'::regclass,'public.member_badges'::regclass)
union all
select 'publication', pubname, tablename from pg_publication_tables where tablename in ('badges','member_badges')
union all
select 'rowcount', 'badges', (select count(*)::text from public.badges)
union all
select 'rowcount', 'member_badges', (select count(*)::text from public.member_badges);
